subject: Human Evolution
title: The Paleo Diet Myth
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Paleo Diet Myth usable.

hook.text: The paleo diet claims to eat like our ancestors. But which ancestors? They ate wildly different things.

buildup.text: Arctic peoples ate almost pure fat. Tropical foragers ate tubers and fruit. There was no single paleo diet.

discovery.text: The only certainty: ancient diets were whole, unprocessed, seasonal, and locally sourced.

twist.text: Modern 'paleo' products are industrial foods dressed up as ancestral—the opposite of what our ancestors ate.

climax.text: The lesson isn't a specific food list. It's that processing and abundance are the real modern problems.

punchline.text: There was no one paleo diet. There were thousands.

quiz.question: Why is the idea of a single 'paleo diet' misleading?
options: Ancient humans ate the same foods everywhere
Ancestral diets varied hugely by region and climate
The paleo diet is scientifically proven
